scope: Full tower, excluding OS and monitor.
override_note: DEFAULT data. The caller overrides these bands at runtime (pass --bands <file> to pc_check.py, or supply your own bands to the page generator). Band edges are budgets, not product prices: product prices always come from the caller's database.
context: UK DDR5 cost about 4.95x its Sep 2025 level in July 2026 (peak 5.28x in March 2026), so the typical build inside a band moves with memory and GPU pricing. Allocate from runtime prices, never from fixed percentage splits.

bands.typical: APU with 32 GB, or a 6-core with an entry GPU
